accepted_boundaries: Both public donor revisions are explicit OTS source hypotheses, without claims of independent Global authority.
Five exact trade callbacks retain denied NotEqual branches and allowed Equal branches; unknown source progress remains unqualified.
All source-track identities already exist in the source registry. Native predicate/gate/transition/effect/variant bindings remain null, and native Quest/track/transition declarations are empty.
Two travel action proofs retain exact Mission01 equality guards, source writes, fare, destination and callback/action registration in both donor repositories.
Source debit-before-cooldown and action-on-refusal findings are source defects, not proposed native behavior.

Proposed travel validates all gates before durable fee+pending-arrival+qualified-effects commit, then performs fenced placement. A known commit remains authoritative through disconnect, placement failure and recovery; no automatic rollback or atomic physical move is claimed.
ExampleQuest>=1 remains rejected placeholder evidence. Rank>=3 remains a prospective title hypothesis; all 171 discount routes remain on hold until exact Global eligibility is qualified.
Eight quote/donor fare disagreements preserve separate retained quote custody and donor candidate fare. Fluid/charge evidence is not reinterpreted as transaction units.
Citizen is a named title dependency, with no fabricated tally threshold, track or native gate.
All631 relation outputs and the packet remain OFFLINE_AUTHORING_ONLY/runtime_eligible=false.

findings.closure: All171 registration pointers now resolve to the whole owning route, whose canonical hash equals row_sha256; independently named discount_field_pointer/hash bind the scalar field. Compiler validates route shape/hash and field parent/hash. The new regression independently reads actual candidate JSON and rejects old scalar pointers for every sibling.
findings.consequence: All emitted registration_custody pointer/hash pairs fail independent re-resolution; the original whole-route provenance cannot be checked using the published witness.
findings.repair: Emit a whole-route pointer paired with the current whole-route hash; optionally retain a separately named discount field pointer. Preserve the source observation original pointer as its own source custody.
findings.required_regression: Resolve every one of the 171 registration_custody pointers against its declared source file, independently hash the resolved object using canonical sorted JSON, and compare with row_sha256. Assert the resolved object has the route destination, fare and discount fields, rather than changing the test to accept a field hash.
findings.root_cause: promotion_pointer addresses the route discount field, while row_sha256 hashes the containing route object.
findings.title: Discount registration pointer and row digest identify different source values

limitations: Tests classify authoring dependencies and source-only previews. They do not exercise a native service execution engine or qualify any owning runtime contracts.
scope: Whole module, read-only independent review of R11 offline source-service compiler; no repository mutations or runtime admission.
